change_summary: Keep Project roots as identity and project-wide control surfaces while materializing independent reader jobs in non-Project branches and leaves.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill passes the Project-root versus reader-job boundary without prescribing Project names, leaf taxonomy, child count, or depth.

server_contract.note: The server keeps Project roots as identity and compact project-wide control surfaces while first-plan Mission and RunOps semantics materialize independent content duties; Runtime remains a non-semantic executor.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35; their shared server-discovered processing-profile contract remains compatible and needs no CLI protocol change.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the public Skill page projects this shared package and the release does not change remote MCP connection or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the new Skill release; the full Skill carries the Project-root and independent-reader-owner handoff boundary.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Harness distinguishes structural Project identity from substantive reader-job ownership and keeps the single-control-question countercase without shape quotas.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Focused Prompt, Mission, RunOps, Host-routing and package gates cover root-body compression, the compact-root countercase and unchanged Runtime authority; fresh Codex effect/readback remains the release acceptance gate.
